18703800_715e9b7d.text: Both the cortical amygdalar nuclei and the basolateral amygdalar nuclear complex, which is located deeper within the amygdaloid complex, have cortex-like cell types (McDonald et al., 2016). In contrast, the so called "extended amygdalar nuclei" contain predominantly GABAergic spiny projection neurons, like the striatum (McDonald et al., 2016).
